command_line:
set +e
exec > probe.txt 2>&1
PIP_USER=0 python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --target "$PWD/.deps" pip==21.3.1
export PYTHONPATH="$PWD/.deps"
PIP_USER=0 python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --target "$PWD/.deps" caper==1.0.0
export PATH="$PWD/.deps/bin:$PATH"
mkdir -p "$PWD/caper_home"
export HOME="$PWD/caper_home"
caper init local --conf "$PWD/caper.conf" --local-loc-dir "$PWD/caper_tmp"
echo init_rc=$?
printf '%s\n' '--- caper_home ---'
find "$PWD/caper_home" -maxdepth 4 -type f -printf '%p %s\n' | sort
printf '%s\n' '--- conf ---'
cat "$PWD/caper.conf" 2>/dev/null | head -200
printf '%s\n' '--- java ---'
java -version 2>&1
exit 0
